description: Destination handling of CompactDatabase on the rich ACCDB fixture: a new destination; the same call again onto the now existing destination; destination equal to the source path; destination equal to an existing file; and for each spelling of the input path (upper, extended, slashes, dot) a compaction from that spelling to a new file and a compaction from the plain path onto that spelling of itself. File images are kept after the same-path attempt; counts of Parent are read from each result.
retentionNote: Designed r-cplx-rebuild probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
